text:
incident-bot: PAGER: SEV-2 - inference-runtime elevated latencies detected. Metric: kvcache.evictions.rate spiked x12, batching fallback triggered on several nodes. Affected: hosted text-gen API (5% of requests saw >2x tail latency). Paging @maya for live mitigation.

maya: Oncall Maya here, on it. Joining bridge in 2 mins. Anyone already running mitigations?

samir: I'm on it — started a canary rollout with conservative kv eviction limits. Changed env `KVCACHE_MAX_ENTRIES=800000` on prod-canary, command: `kubectl -n inference set env deploy/runtime KVCACHE_MAX_ENTRIES=800000 --record`. Observing reduced evictions on the canary nodes.

priya: I disabled the aggressive batching fallback path on canary to prevent immediate batch collapse: `BATCHER_ENABLE_FALLBACK=false`. This should keep latency stable while we watch kv thrash.

maya: Good. Priya/Samir keep canary for 15m, then we can roll forward if stable. Customer impact: flagged to CS — top 3 high-throughput customers may have seen degraded latency spikes. No errors or data loss reported.

daniel: Link to runbook and telemetry: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/INF/pages/kv-cache-missstorm and dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/kvcache/evictions. Adding post-incident doc skeleton.

ops-bot: DEPLOYMENT: prod-canary runtime updated by samir (build 2026.03.17-87). Health checks passing on 2/3 canary pods.

maya: Ok canary looks healthy at 12m. Samir please start a gradual roll to 10% with 5m pause. Priya, keep batching fallback disabled until we validate.

samir: Rolled to 10% now: `kubectl rollout pause && kubectl rollout resume` with canary traffic policy. Watching.

priya: Noted. Also capturing `strace`/`perf` snapshots on canary nodes to see if kernel selection changes (from last week's runtime patch) correlate with increased memory churn.

maya: Customer comms: @cs-team notified via slack and email. Internal note: outage window ~T-00:12 to T+00:00, brief tail latency increase peaking at T-00:05. No SLO burn beyond short spike.

samir: Early hypothesis: recent kernel selection heuristics caused suboptimal KV cache eviction patterns under certain seq-length distributions, exposing a memory churn loop that increased evictions and triggered batching fallback.

maya: Action items (assignments + due):
- [ ] Reproduce KV eviction spike locally with loadgen profile (samir) — due EOD today (4201129999).
- [ ] Run kernel-selection rollback test on canary/DUT and measure evictions (priya) — due tomorrow 0900 PST (4201200000).
- [ ] Add detailed eviction telemetry (per-shard evictions, free-list churn) and alert thresholds (daniel) — due in 72h (4201450000).
- [ ] Draft postmortem + timeline with remediation steps (maya) — due 48h (4201280000).
- [ ] Customer follow-up: CS to send targeted note to affected accounts (cs-team) — done/ongoing.

priya: I'll also open a short-lived feature-flag gate for kernel-selection heuristics so we can A/B test without full rollback.

samir: Reproducer notes: using `loadgen --seq-dist=long-tail --qps=12000 --concurrency=400` triggered similar evictions locally; sharing script in #eng-runtime after this thread.

daniel: Scheduling postmortem review: propose 9am PST tomorrow in #postmortems and invite runtime, infra, product & cs. Maya lead, Samir lead technical root cause.

maya: I'm ok to lead the postmortem. If anyone else wants to co-lead write here. Also please add any logs/console snippets to the postmortem doc.

ops-bot: NOTE: Pager closed by maya at 4201123500 — mitigations stable, canary->10% roll successful.

maya: Closing notes: mitigation path is stable for now. Keep the oncall watch for 6 hours. We'll reconvene in the scheduled postmortem. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

samir: uploading reproducer script + perf traces to doc.

priya: Will follow up with kernel-selection feature-flag PR and test matrix.

daniel: I'll push eviction dashboard panels and a temporary alert rule with a 5m window to catch recurrence.

maya: Great. If recurrence happens, escalate to SEV-1 and mobilize full incident response. For now, move items to the remediation epic and mark the thread resolved.
